doc.title: Mossvale
doc.body: Mossvale is a welcoming green valley, lakeside village and warm morning light. Its music evokes a generous village welcome and a quiet return along the lake, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: fiddle, tin whistle, cittern and bodhran
music_design.motif: A warm phrase skips upward twice, lingers at its crest, then walks gently home. A lilting short-short-long pulse makes its return feel like a familiar welcome.

doc.title: Birchmere
doc.body: Birchmere is silver birches around a peaceful mere and bright fields. Its music evokes a fresh, hopeful waterside melody and a gentle reflection among birches, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: kantele, silver flute, nyckelharpa and brushed seed shaker
music_design.motif: A clear little ripple climbs in even steps and turns down in a longer answering arc. Leave a breath between the two halves, like light moving across still water.

doc.title: Clovermead
doc.body: Clovermead is sunny clover meadows, a little pond and golden copses. Its music evokes a playful meadow dance and an unhurried tune in the afternoon sun, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: mandolin, dancing fiddle, hammered dulcimer and tambourine
music_design.motif: A quick upbeat springs into a playful rising turn, then tumbles back in a repeated skipping rhythm. Its last gesture is longer and sunny, as though the dance pauses to laugh.

doc.title: Fernwood
doc.body: Fernwood is a hidden hamlet in deep ferns beneath green-filtered light. Its music evokes an intimate, winding woodland melody and a curious tune near the fern heart, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: alto recorder, muted viola, theorbo and hollow woodblocks
music_design.motif: A close, curling phrase wanders upward slowly, doubles back, and finds a small sheltered resting place. Unequal lengths and little silences give it the feel of following a hidden path.

doc.title: Elderglade
doc.body: Elderglade is ancient elder trees, a still pool and amber motes. Its music evokes a reverent melody beneath old branches and a luminous, gentle answer by the pool, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: wire-strung harp, viola da gamba, breathy ocarina and suspended finger cymbals
music_design.motif: A single held call opens into a slow ascending arch, answered softly below. Give the returning descent generous space and a reverent, gently luminous stillness.

doc.title: Greypine
doc.body: Greypine is high grey pines, a cold tarn and a watch crag in mist. Its music evokes a searching phrase across the tarn and a cool, spacious watch melody, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: bukkehorn, bowed psaltery, bass viol and sparse stone percussion
music_design.motif: A distant call rises across a wide gap, holds against the wind, then descends in three patient gestures. The rhythm is spare and searching, with a quiet pause before each return.

doc.title: Wolfden
doc.body: Wolfden is a dark pine hollow, wolf lair and black tarn at dusk. Its music evokes a wary, brave melody through the hollow and a guarded theme that finds resolve, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: bass clarinet, hardanger fiddle, bowed double bass and skin drum
music_design.motif: Two low, measured pulses lead into a tense upward reach that retreats before finally standing firm. Keep the repeated figure guarded and steady, with courage rather than menace in its answer.

doc.title: Gullwick
doc.body: Gullwick is a busy fishing harbour, blue bay and farmland in fresh sea air. Its music evokes a lively, welcoming harbour melody and a warm homeward tide tune, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: concertina, fiddle, tenor banjo and spoons
music_design.motif: A jaunty pickup rolls into a broad climbing phrase and a bobbing downward answer. Its swinging long-short rhythm should feel like a harbour greeting, cheerful without rushing.

doc.title: Driftwood Bay
doc.body: Driftwood Bay is a wild strand, weathered wharf and dune grass under grey skies. Its music evokes a wide, weathered shore melody and a wistful tune that endures the salt wind, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: baritone acoustic guitar, low concertina, bowed fiddle and shell shaker
music_design.motif: A weathered phrase rises reluctantly, hangs in the salt air, then settles in a long falling line. The gentle uneven sway returns with the patience of waves against an old wharf.

doc.title: Saltreach
doc.body: Saltreach is white salt flats, tidal edge and pale bluffs in warm mist. Its music evokes an open, shimmering salt-flat melody and a reflective tune at the distant tide, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: glass harmonica, monochord, muted viola and ceramic chimes
music_design.motif: A narrow shimmering figure repeats with a slight lift each time, then spreads into one long downward sigh. Widely spaced entrances leave a bright, open horizon around the melody.

doc.title: Shellstrand
doc.body: Shellstrand is pink shell beaches and green isles in clear turquoise shallows. Its music evokes a lilting island melody and a calm refrain shaped like the ebbing tide, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: ukulele, bamboo flute, lap harp and shell rattles
music_design.motif: A lilting phrase rocks upward and back, then answers with a softer descending wave. Let its three-part sway and rounded pauses feel like clear shallows washing pink shells.

doc.title: Stormhead
doc.body: Stormhead is rain-lashed headland, dark surf and a lone beacon on slate cliffs. Its music evokes a bold melody against the gale and a watchful theme opening toward the beacon, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: French horn, low cello ensemble, bowed cymbal and deep frame drum
music_design.motif: A firm repeated call climbs boldly above a slower pulse and falls in a broad, resolute answer. Stretch the last rise toward a sustained beacon-like crest before returning to the surf.

doc.title: Reedmarsh
doc.body: Reedmarsh is golden reeds, mirror pools and a stilt village in warm mist. Its music evokes a buoyant tune through the reeds and a patient waterborne melody, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: sheng, reed pipe, pizzicato cello and water drum
music_design.motif: A buoyant figure steps up, hesitates, and floats down in a gently offbeat reply. Its light repeated pulse should sound like a small boat nudging through reeds, never a march.

doc.title: Mirewood
doc.body: Mirewood is drowned trees and dark pools under a green firefly haze. Its music evokes a low, searching melody and a slow tune with glimmers in the mire, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: bassoon, bowed tagelharpa, bass viol and scattered wooden clicks
music_design.motif: A low line creeps upward in small uncertain steps, followed by a brief high glimmer and a slow return. Keep the spaces between phrases dark and patient, but let the answer retain warmth.

doc.title: Fenhollow
doc.body: Fenhollow is peat fen, pale pools and an old dig beneath a soft grey sky. Its music evokes a curious, measured excavation theme and a quiet echo of buried history, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: viola da gamba, plucked zither, alto ocarina and peat-dry hand percussion
music_design.motif: A measured descending question is answered by a modest climb and a lingering turn. The repeated rhythm is curious and deliberate, as if carefully uncovering something long buried.

doc.title: Sunken Kirk
doc.body: Sunken Kirk is a half-drowned stone kirk and churchyard among cold pools. Its music evokes a graceful memorial melody and a mournful theme slowly finding light, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: small chamber organ, cello, handbells and bowed psaltery
music_design.motif: A solemn held opening falls gently, then rises again in a longer consoling phrase. Give the melody a slow processional breath and an ending that finds light rather than final despair.

doc.title: Bogheart
doc.body: Bogheart is deep brown bog pools and a toadstool wood under yellow-grey sky. Its music evokes a wary, earthy wandering melody and an uncanny tune that keeps its warmth, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: contrabassoon, jaw harp, low viola and dry skin drum
music_design.motif: A short earthy pulse circles a low resting place before making one cautious upward leap. The answer folds back in an uneven, softly loping rhythm, uncanny but companionable.

doc.title: Sporefen
doc.body: Sporefen is a luminous fungal marsh and tall toadstools over green water. Its music evokes a curious, buoyant melody and a softly enchanted drifting theme, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: marimba, kalimba, bamboo panpipes and plucked cello
music_design.motif: Small buoyant gestures hop upward with a pause after each, then drift down in a smooth answering ribbon. Keep a delicate syncopated pulse beneath its softly curious glow.

doc.title: Stonestep
doc.body: Stonestep is a quarry town, pale stone steps, green meadow and watchful moor. Its music evokes a welcoming hill-country melody and a broad tune climbing the quarry steps, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: mountain dulcimer, sturdy fiddle, tenor recorder and quarry-stone taps
music_design.motif: A sturdy repeated step grows into a broad uphill phrase, then comes down more easily than it climbed. Its even walking rhythm opens into a generous held welcome at the top.

doc.title: Heatherfell
doc.body: Heatherfell is violet heather moor, scree and a small high tarn. Its music evokes an airy roaming melody and a wistful hillside refrain, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: Scottish smallpipes, open fiddle, bouzouki and light bodhran
music_design.motif: An airy rising call opens wide, then curls gently down through a lilting answer. Let a little delayed accent give the refrain the freedom of wandering over heather.

doc.title: Oldwall
doc.body: Oldwall is broken ancient walls in bracken and autumn woods. Its music evokes a nostalgic melody by the old stones and a dignified theme of a forgotten kingdom, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: lute, viola d'amore, cor anglais and soft handbell
music_design.motif: A dignified phrase rises from a quiet pickup and descends in two wistful arches. A lingering final turn returns like a half-remembered story, with a measured autumnal warmth.

doc.title: Kingsbarrow
doc.body: Kingsbarrow is a royal barrow and timber hall on a shadowed moor. Its music evokes a noble but weathered hall melody and a quiet memorial for the buried king, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: lur horn, lyre, low viols and measured ceremonial drum
music_design.motif: A noble long call is answered lower by three deliberate pulses and a slow upward recovery. Hold the crest with restraint, then let the memorial refrain settle without triumphal bustle.

doc.title: Giantsteps
doc.body: Giantsteps is a monumental basalt stair across grey crags and lonely stonefield. Its music evokes a broad melody climbing the stair and a spacious theme from the summit, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: alphorn, resonant double bass, bass drum and stone lithophone
music_design.motif: A huge low gesture climbs in widely separated strides, pausing on each ledge before a spacious falling answer. The pulse is slow and monumental, with the summit opening into still air.

doc.title: Glowcap Hollow
doc.body: Glowcap Hollow is a blue-dusk village under immense glowing mushrooms. Its music evokes a gentle wonder-filled melody and a playful nocturnal village tune, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: celesta, toy-sized music box, pizzicato viola and soft udu
music_design.motif: A tiny repeated sparkle climbs in a playful curl, pauses, and tiptoes back down. Keep a gentle nocturnal bounce, with the answer slightly longer and full of wonder.

doc.title: Gleamdeep
doc.body: Gleamdeep is violet mushroom woods, amethyst stone and shining pools. Its music evokes a luminous winding melody and a serene theme reflected in crystal water, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: crystal singing bowls, koto, harmonics on cello and delicate triangle
music_design.motif: A luminous phrase winds upward in a smooth ribbon, turns once at its brightest point, and pours gently down. Unhurried repeated ripples should feel reflected rather than echoed mechanically.

doc.title: Shardvault
doc.body: Shardvault is a pale crystal vault among cold shards and blue-white water. Its music evokes a precise, mysterious vault melody and an expansive theme in the cold light, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: glass marimba, bowed vibraphone, contrabass and high recorder
music_design.motif: A precise short figure rises angularly, stops in a clear silence, then answers with a much broader descending arc. The regular pulse is fragile and crystalline, opening into cold spaciousness.

doc.title: Dustmere
doc.body: Dustmere is a dry vanished lake, old shoreline and last well in dusty air. Its music evokes a spare, resilient travel melody and a wistful memory of water, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: setar, low ney, clay darbuka and bowed rebab
music_design.motif: A spare wandering call rises, falters, and falls in a dry little turn, answered by a longer memory of the same shape. A patient walking pulse carries resilience through the empty shoreline.

doc.title: Palmwell
doc.body: Palmwell is a palm oasis and caravan camp among golden dunes. Its music evokes a warm caravan traveling melody and a restful tune in green shade by water, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: oud, qanun, bright ney and riq
music_design.motif: A warm circling phrase climbs with a quick ornament and rests in a shaded, gently falling answer. Its lilting caravan pulse relaxes on the return, like arriving beside water.

doc.title: Sunscar Dunes
doc.body: Sunscar Dunes is white-hot dunes, buried ruins, bones and a dark scar in sand. Its music evokes a tense, wide-open crossing theme and a searching melody rising above the dunes, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: kamancheh, zurna played softly, low strings and restrained daf
music_design.motif: A tense low repetition gathers into a long ascending reach, interrupted by a brief falling turn. Let the rhythm feel like deliberate steps across hot dunes, with the last answer opening toward resolve.

doc.title: Redmesa
doc.body: Redmesa is red sandstone buttes, clay slopes and a spring at copper sunset. Its music evokes a spacious red-rock melody and a warm, wandering tune toward the spring, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: cedar flute, acoustic guitar, bowed cello and rawhide hand drum
music_design.motif: A wide, sun-warmed call rises over a slow pulse and falls across a long spacious answer. A small repeated turn at its end should suggest the spring found after an unhurried journey.

doc.title: Tombsands
doc.body: Tombsands is dusk over a sand-buried necropolis, sunken tombs and pale cliffs. Its music evokes an ancient theme gathering grandeur as the lost city appears and a solemn melody settling into peace among the tombs, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: duduk, ney, oud, low bowed strings, sparse bronze bells and slow frame drum
music_design.motif: A low sustained call lifts in three slow breaths, bends gently back, and is answered beneath it by a longer descending lament. Return to that contour over a measured, spacious pulse, solemn and ancient but gradually finding peace.

doc.title: Frostmoor
doc.body: Frostmoor is a scoured snowy moor, stunted pines and dark tarn in wind. Its music evokes a wind-bitten crossing melody and a brave, measured theme in the cold, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: seljefloyte, bowed lyre, low cello and sparse ice-like chimes
music_design.motif: A thin high call rises against a firm low pulse, breaks into two short falling gestures, then recovers. Leave wind-like space between returns while keeping the refrain brave and measured.

doc.title: Rimeholt
doc.body: Rimeholt is a sheltering holt among frost-coated trees and a glacier. Its music evokes a cozy winter refuge melody and a hushed, crystalline snow theme, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: accordion, warm fiddle, plucked kantele and soft sleigh bells
music_design.motif: A hushed upward curl settles into a rocking answer, then repeats with a little more warmth. Its easy long-short sway should feel like shelter while snow falls quietly outside.

doc.title: Frostpine
doc.body: Frostpine is deep snow-covered spruce and a remote logger camp. Its music evokes a dark, steady woodland tune and a hushed snowfall melody, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: tagelharpa, bass recorder, plucked mandola and muffled hand drum
music_design.motif: A dark low figure walks steadily upward, pauses beneath a held tone, and returns in a slow falling line. Keep the repeated rhythm close and even, like footsteps softened by deep snow.

doc.title: Icefall
doc.body: Icefall is a blue glacier fall, deep crevasses and a cold tarn. Its music evokes a cascading, clear melody and a cautious crossing tune above the ice, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: hammered glass dulcimer, high violin harmonics, pulsing cello and crystal chimes
music_design.motif: A clear cascade descends in quick little groups, answered by a careful slower ascent. The pulse remains steady beneath the glitter, with a suspended pause before crossing back.

doc.title: Whitepeak
doc.body: Whitepeak is an immense white summit above snowfields in thin air. Its music evokes an open melody reaching the summit and a still, majestic theme in clear air, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: alpine horn, soaring violins, open-string viola and sparse wind chimes
music_design.motif: A broad ascending arch reaches a long still crest before descending in two generous breaths. The spacious rhythm should feel weightless and majestic, not hurried or victorious.

doc.title: Emberfall
doc.body: Emberfall is a forge town below falling embers and lava cliffs. Its music evokes a determined forge melody and a warm but uneasy tune beside the fires, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: hammered dulcimer, low fiddle, cello, anvil taps and hand drum
music_design.motif: A determined short-short-long figure climbs, holds, and comes back in a warm resolute answer. The repeated working pulse should soften on its return, keeping humanity beside the forge.

doc.title: Cinderreach
doc.body: Cinderreach is black ash flats, volcanic vents and a dim ash-filled sky. Its music evokes a weathered journey through stillness and heat and a stark melody gathering strength toward calm, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: bass trombone, bowed double bass, low cello and restrained volcanic drum
music_design.motif: A stark low phrase crosses a wide interval and slowly sinks back, then rises farther on its next return. Long held gestures over sparse pulses gather strength without becoming frantic.

doc.title: Ashkeep
doc.body: Ashkeep is a lonely grey keep and gate in a cold ashfield. Its music evokes a noble, weary melody and a humane last-watch theme, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: muted French horn, viola da gamba, low strings and solitary tower bell
music_design.motif: A weary noble call rises once, falls in a long gentle arc, and is answered by a small stubborn lift. Let each measured return feel like keeping watch for someone, humane rather than martial.

doc.title: The Maw
doc.body: The Maw is an immense fiery chasm at the scorched edge of the world. Its music evokes a grave heroic finale and a dark climb toward a hard-won hopeful ending, with room for quiet exploration and a sense of belonging even at the world's difficult edges.

music_design.instruments: contrabass strings, bass trombone, deep timpani and measured war drums
music_design.motif: A grave repeated low call climbs in increasingly broad strides, answers with a heavy descent, and climbs again toward a hard-won open crest. Keep the pulse deliberate and the final return hopeful without erasing its weight.
